description: Shared nullable children keep one close sequence per chart structure.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text ($x:empty (ε | r16)) %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(empty)

%rule empty ε
%rule r0 [+T]
%rule r1 (r0 r0)
%rule r2 (r1 r1)
%rule r3 (r2 r2)
%rule r4 (r3 r3)
%rule r5 (r4 r4)
%rule r6 (r5 r5)
%rule r7 (r6 r6)
%rule r8 (r7 r7)
%rule r9 (r8 r8)
%rule r10 (r9 r9)
%rule r11 (r10 r10)
%rule r12 (r11 r11)
%rule r13 (r12 r12)
%rule r14 (r13 r13)
%rule r15 (r14 r14)
%rule r16 (r15 r15)
